section.title: org.osgi.service.configurator.annotations
section.para: This package contains annotations that can be used to require the Configurator extender.
Bundles should not normally need to import this package as the annotations are only used at build-time.

listitem.para: RequireConfigurator - This annotation can be used to require the Configurator extender.

section.title: @RequireConfigurator
section.para: This annotation can be used to require the Configurator extender. It can be used directly, or as a meta-annotation.
This annotation allows users to define custom locations that should be searched for configuration files using RequireConfigurator.value()

section.title: String[] value default {}
section.para: This attribute can be used to define one or more locations that the configurator must search, in order, for configuration files.
If no locations are defined then the Configurator default of /OSGI-INF/configurator will be used.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A list of bundle locations containing configuration files
